For a shedding dog + hard floors + rugs, I’d shortlist Dreame, Roborock, and Ecovacs first. The big things that matter are hair pickup, anti-tangle brush design, rug/carpet handling, obstacle avoidance, and the cost/availability of consumables. Suction numbers alone aren't a good buying metric.

How I'd compare maintenance cost

Don't just compare the purchase price. Calculate 3-year ownership cost:

3-year cost = robot + replacement brushes + filters + mop pads + dust bags + cleaning solution + batteries/repairs

For a dog household, I'd pay particular attention to:

Main roller replacement
This is probably the most important consumable for you. Look for a genuinely anti-tangle roller rather than just high advertised suction.

Side brush
Dog hair can wrap around the side brush, so check replacement frequency and price.

Filters
You'll probably replace/clean these more frequently than a hair-free household.

Dust bags
Self-empty docks are fantastic with a shedding dog, but check the price of proprietary bags. A cheap robot can become expensive if bags are ₹1,000+ per pack.

Mop pads + cleaning solution
Less important if you're primarily buying it for vacuuming, but relevant if you want automated mopping.

Availability in India
This is a big one. I'd strongly prefer a model where brushes, filters, bags and mop pads are readily available in India, rather than relying on imports.

Warranty/service
A ₹50k robot with good Indian service can be a better buy than a ₹90k imported flagship with questionable support.

What I'd personally buy

If you're comfortable spending around ₹70–80k, I'd start with the Dreame L50s Pro Ultra.

If your priority is maximum dog-hair pickup rather than mopping, I'd lean Roborock Qrevo Curv. If you want to spend less, I'd investigate the Dreame D20 Ultra / L40 Gen 2 pricing before buying.

One important point: don't overpay for fancy mopping features if your main problem is dog hair. Put that money toward a better anti-tangle vacuum system, reliable navigation, auto-emptying, and good rug performance.
